# Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts

> > A culinary arts school offering education in cooking techniques, pastry arts, and food safety with campuses in Austin and Boulder.

Escoffier provides culinary education through hands-on training and curriculum covering foundational cooking skills, baking and pastry techniques, food safety standards, and industry trends. The school maintains an active blog exploring culinary innovation, regional dining scenes, and professional development for aspiring chefs.

## Key Topics

- Culinary Arts Education
- Cooking Techniques
- Pastry Arts & Baking
- Food Safety Standards
- Austin Campus
- Boulder Campus
- Restaurant Industry
- Culinary Innovation
- Food Technology
- Regional Cuisine
- Professional Chef Training
- Food Photography
- Menu Development
- European Cuisine
- Local Food Sourcing

## Culinary Techniques & Skills

- [How To Properly Handle Meats](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/how-to-properly-handle-meats): Food safety tips for proper meat handling in kitchen environments
- [How to Make Glazed Carrots](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/recipes/how-to-make-glazed-carrots): Student recipe guide for glazed carrots from Foundations curriculum
- [The Possibilities of Schnitzel](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/the-possibilities-of-schnitzel): Explores schnitzel varieties and breading techniques in German cuisine
- [Seafood bakes and boils offer eaters a unique thrill](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/seafood-bakes-and-boils-offer-eaters-a-unique-thrill): Details seafood bake and boil techniques for group dining experiences
- [What Makes A Lobster Roll Great?](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/what-makes-a-lobster-roll-great): Explores lobster roll preparation and Northeast regional cuisine
- [Flavorful falafel: Chickpeas reporting for duty](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/flavorful-falafel-chickpeas-reporting-for-duty): Middle Eastern falafel preparation and chickpea cooking techniques
- [Try these grilled fruits for your next BBQ](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/try-these-grilled-fruits-for-your-next-bbq): Grilled fruit techniques for BBQ desserts and drinks

## Pastry Arts & Baking Education

- [What's driving the rise of pastry arts academies?](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/baking-pastry/whats-driving-the-rise-of-pastry-arts-academies): Examines growth of pastry arts academies and career opportunities
- [Celebrate National S'mores Day With 6 Filling S'mores Hacks](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/baking-pastry/celebrate-national-smores-day-with-6-filling-smores-hacks): Creative s'mores recipe variations for National S'mores Day Aug 10

## Professional Development & Industry Skills

- [Tips For Photographing A Beautiful Dish](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/tips-for-photographing-a-beautiful-dish): Food photography tips for menus, portfolios, and social media
- [Website optimization tips for restaurant menus](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/website-optimization-tips-for-restaurant-menus): Digital marketing strategies for optimizing restaurant menu websites
- ["Peach" application offers new take on local food sourcing](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/peach-application-offers-new-take-on-local-food-sourcing): Reviews Peach app connecting chefs with local farmers and wholesalers

## Culinary Innovation & Food Technology

- [The Future Of Food: 3-D Printing](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/world-food-drink/the-future-of-food-3-d-printing): Explores 3D printing technology applications in food production
- [Supercomputer cooking](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/world-food-drink/supercomputer-cooking): IBM supercomputer culinary innovation showcased at SXSW Texas
- [The Internet's Most Viral Foods](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/culinary-arts/the-internets-most-viral-foods): Covers trending viral foods and social media food culture

## Food Safety & Industry News

- [Lawsuit filed over salmonella outbreak in Texas](https://www.escoffier.edu/blog/world-food-drink/lawsuit-filed-over-salmonella-outbreak-in-texas): News on Texas salmonella outbreak lawsuit and food safety implications
